newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian OLOs little moved by Greenspan, eye Buba.
newsitem.headline: Belgian OLOs little moved by Greenspan, eye Buba.

text.p: Belgian linear bonds closed marginally firmer on Tuesday after initial gains which followed a slump in Germany's Ifo business confidence index were eroded in the afternoon despite market-bolstering comments by Federal Reserve chairman Alan Greenspan.

"The initial reaction to the Greenspan speech is neutral," one trader said. "Now it's the Bundesbank meeting, next week the auction (in Belgium). We may well hang on to these levels for now," one trader said.
The benchmark 2007 OLO closed at 5.818 percent against 5.82 percent on Monday.
Traders noted switching trades throughout the curve on relatively small volumes.

They said that the full impact of Greenspan's comments on the U.S. market would only be felt on Wednesday, although the final trades of the day, half an hour after the close, shaved the 10-year OLO yield to 5.80 percent.
